subject: Re: Demo request — hold until budget gating clarified
body:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas M. <lucas@brightline.io>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — can we do Wed the 18th?

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re excited to see Redwood in action. Are you available to run a 45-minute demo with our ML infra and procurement teams on Wed, Aug 18 at 11:00am PT? That time works for Lucas and me.

Our ask: show model routing and quota/usage reporting (we have an upcoming capex review). I can share a brief one‑pager ahead of time.

Best,
Sanjay
Director, Platform Engineering
Brightline Technologies

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
Cc: Lucas M. <lucas@brightline.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — can we do Wed the 18th?

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the request and the context. I’m glad to hear the procurement and infra folks will join. Quick update on our side: two things have come up that make the 18th risky for a productive session:

- My team (Rishi and I) will be traveling on the 17–19 roadshow for a strategic partner demo (we're onsite in SF), so we’d be split across time zones and may not be able to show the live Dedicated cluster flow reliably.
- We also learned your finance team has a short internal freeze window the week of Aug 23 as they finalize FY26 carryovers — based on what you said, it sounds like your capex gating might land very close to that.

Given both, I suggest we pause scheduling until your capex gating is clarified so we can align the demo to the right audience and avoid a replay. If you need something sooner, I can do a 30-minute executive overview (recorded) that covers routing and billing, but recommend the full technical demo after the budget window.

I attached a one‑page RFI template and a proposed set of slots after your budget review (Aug 31–Sep 3). If it helps, Rishi can surface a pricing cushion for a funded Q4 commit; Monica can coordinate a short architecture deep‑dive once dates are locked.

Next steps:
- If you want to hold, confirm when your capex gating clears (even a tentative date) — I’ll mark tentative slots.
- If you prefer the quick executive overview this week, tell me which day/time and I’ll record and forward.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachments: RFI_Spend_Timeline.xlsx

---

From: Lucas M. <lucas@brightline.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — can we do Wed the 18th?

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up and the doc.

Quick note: finance confirmed an internal "planning freeze" starting Aug 20 while they reconcile vendor commitments for Q4. Looks like we should aim for the first week of Sept for a full technical demo. Could you tentatively hold Tues/Wed Sept 1–2? Marcus from procurement will join if we confirm, and he is focused on consumption models and SLAs.

Appreciate the flexibility.
— Lucas

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lucas M. <lucas@brightline.io>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightline.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — can we do Wed the 18th?

Perfect — thanks Lucas. I’ve tentatively held Tue Sep 1 10:00–11:00 PT and Wed Sep 2 11:00–12:00 PT on our side. I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm which slot is best.

Rishi, Monica — looping you both to prep:
- Rishi: please prepare a short slide on pricing sensitivity for reserved capacity vs host-on-demand; highlight the tradeoffs for a Q4 commit.
- Monica: can you outline a 15‑minute tech segment showing caching and KV cache reuse for streaming workloads?

I also attached an .ics with the two tentative slots for Marcus to accept.

Thanks — Vanessa

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — can we do Wed the 18th?

On it — I’ll draft the pricing slide and include a 10%/15%/20% committed‑usage scenario with short notes on SLA tiers. Monica, I’ll sync with you on the tech outline to ensure the caching demo is reproducible on Dedicated.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

---

[ATTACHMENT STUBS]
- RFI_Spend_Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB) — Brightline: timeline and gating dates
- proposed_slots.ics (calendar invite, 2KB) — tentative Sept 1–2 slots

[THREAD NOTES]
- Status: Demo deferred from Aug 18 to tentative Sept 1–2 due to vendor travel and Brightline planning freeze.
- Action: Brightline to confirm post-freeze date; Redwood to prepare pricing sensitivity and caching demo.
- Internal follow-up tasks assigned to rishi_malhotra and monica_patel.
